summary.text: Daniel Martinez is the Republican candidate for the Montana House of Representatives, District 64, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
According to Ballotpedia, he earned a high school diploma from Sahuarita High School and his career experience includes working as a driver.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Daniel Martinez described himself as a blue-collar worker who has supported a family on a paycheck and said he is running for House District 64 to fight for working families.
He listed transparent health care pricing, taxes and a balanced budget, and public lands among his key messages, and said he is passionate about public access to Montana's public lands.

sources.title: Daniel Martinez - Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey (2026)
